# The release tags (D-129): tag, commit, title. The Release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml) checks the pilot
# release on a Windows laptop with the real LM Studio, then creates each tag missing here with its GitHub release; the
# newest pilot release (its last pilot line) gets the offline install zip it checked; an earlier pilot keeps its own.
# A new tag's commit must hold main's workflow files: the workflow's token may not push a tag that would add or change
# a workflow (GitHub refuses it without the "workflows" permission), so tag a commit of main, not one from before.
